parameters.description:
`msg-to-dot` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your DOT destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own DOT destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional DOT destinations bound per enrollment.

Open the Dot. mobile app, enable the Text API content slot for your device, then retrieve the device's API token (starts with `dot_app_`) and its 12-character hex serial number from the device settings screen. Set the token as DOT_APIKEY and the serial number as DOT_DEVICE_ID; UnitySVC posts your title and body directly to that device's Text API.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment DOT destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to DOT device API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own DOT destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's DOT apikey

device_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's DOT device id
